# Command reference

51 commands. Every user action is a command: the menus, the CLI (`forge cmd`), RPC (`command.run`), MCP (one tool per command, name with `.` replaced by `_`) and scripts (`run(id, #{...})`) all run the same handlers. Angles are degrees, percentages as shown, node ids are integers.

| Id | Label | Undoable | MCP tool |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`object.create`](#objectcreate) | Create | yes | `object_create` |

| [`object.rename`](#objectrename) | Rename | yes | `object_rename` |
| [`object.reparent`](#objectreparent) | Move | yes | `object_reparent` |
| [`edit.undo`](#editundo) | Undo | no | `edit_undo` |

## `object`

### `object.create`

Create. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | yes | Node type id, e.g. `forge.cube`. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.create --args '{"type":"forge.cube"}'`

### `object.delete`

Delete. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Node ids; the current selection when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.delete --args '{"nodes":[1]}'`

### `object.rename`

Rename. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.rename --args '{"name":"Box","node":1}'`

### `object.reparent`

Move. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `parent` | integer or null | no | New parent; null moves to the root level. Appended as the last child. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.reparent --args '{"node":2,"parent":1}'`

## `transform`

### `transform.set`

Set Transform. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `pos` | array of number (length 3) or null | no | Position `[x, y, z]`. |
| `rot` | array of number (length 3) or null | no | Rotation `[h, p, b]` in degrees. |
| `scale` | array of number (length 3) or null | no | Scale `[x, y, z]`. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge transform.set --args '{"node":1,"pos":[0.0,100.0,0.0],"rot":[90.0,0.0,0.0],"scale":[1.0,1.0,1.0]}'`

### `mesh.extrude`

Extrude. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |
| `polys` | array of integer or null | no | Polygon indices; the stored polygon selection when absent. |
| `settings` | object | no | Tool settings; absent keys keep the factory defaults. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.extrude --args '{"polys":[0],"settings":{"offset":10.0}}'`

### `mesh.bevel`

Bevel. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edges` | array of integer \| array of integer (length 2) or null | no | Edges (edge mode): edge ids of the mesh, or point pairs [a, b]. |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |
| `points` | array of integer or null | no | Point indices (point mode). |
| `polys` | array of integer or null | no | Polygon indices (polygon mode). When none of polys, edges, points is given the stored selection is used. |
| `settings` | object | no | Tool settings; absent keys keep the factory defaults. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.bevel --args '{"polys":[0],"settings":{"offset":10.0}}'`

## `param`

### `param.set`

Set Parameter. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `param` | string | yes | Parameter id. |
| `value` | any | yes | Bool, number, `[x, y, z]`, string, node id or null, or an array of indices. Angles are degrees and percentages are as shown (50 is 50 %). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge param.set --args '{"node":1,"param":"size","value":2.5}'`


## `key`

### `key.record`

Record. One undo step.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge key.record --args '{}'`

### `key.delete_at_frame`

Delete Keys. One undo step.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge key.delete_at_frame --args '{}'`

### `key.jump`

Jump to Key. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `forward` | boolean | yes | true: next key, false: previous key. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge key.jump --args '{"forward":true}'`

### `key.set`

Set Key. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `track` | string | yes | Track: an animatable float parameter id, or `<vec3 param>.<x\|y\|z>` (`transform.pos.x`, `transform.rot.y`, `transform.scale.z`). |
| `frame` | integer | yes | Frame of the key (any integer; fps comes from the project). |
| `value` | number | yes | Value in display units (degrees for angles, percent as shown). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge key.set --args '{"frame":10,"node":1,"track":"transform.pos.x","value":100.0}'`

### `key.autokey`

Autokey. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean or null | no | New state; the current one is flipped when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge key.autokey --args '{"enabled":true}'`


## `timeline`

### `timeline.set_frame`

Go to Frame. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frame` | integer | yes | Frame number, clamped to the project range. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge timeline.set_frame --args '{"frame":10}'`

### `timeline.step`

Step Frames. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delta` | integer | yes | Frames to move by (negative goes back). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge timeline.step --args '{"delta":1}'`

### `timeline.play`

Play. Not an undoable edit.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge timeline.play --args '{}'`

### `timeline.stop`

Stop. Not an undoable edit.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge timeline.stop --args '{}'`

### `timeline.settings`

Timeline Settings. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fps` | integer | yes | Frames per second, 1 to 240. |
| `start` | integer | yes | First frame of the project range. |
| `end` | integer | yes | Last frame of the project range. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge timeline.settings --args '{"end":90,"fps":30,"start":0}'`
